verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs show broad API coverage across core product functions—card creation, authorization rules, disputes, KYC, webhooks/events, sandbox simulation, and versioning—consistent with an API-first platform where the dashboard is a thin layer over these same endpoints. However, there is no explicit statement or audit confirming full UI/API parity (e.g., no explicit note that every dashboard action has an API equivalent), and no OpenAPI spec was found to verify endpoint completeness (probe shows 404s for openapi.json variants). Missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity claim/documentation, a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage, and independent/community confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
